datasets.title: IMPORTS
datasets.description: Statistical information regarding the acquisition of goods abroad that have entered through the country's main ports and airports, classified into sections of the Central American Tariff System (SAC).

datasets.title: EXPORTS
datasets.description: Statistical information regarding the departure of goods through the different ports and airports of the country, classified by sections of the Central American Tariff System (SAC).

datasets.title: Livestock Slaughter
datasets.description: Statistical information belonging to both municipal slaughterhouses (slaughter for domestic consumption) and private slaughterhouses (export-type livestock slaughter).

datasets.title: RISK MANAGEMENT
datasets.description: This chapter presents events and emergencies recorded in the country, along with their effects on people, housing, infrastructure, and crops. The displayed tables are part of the collection of administrative records on Risk Management and Disaster Response during 2025, compiled from the sources: INSIVUMEH, MAGA, and SECONRED.

datasets.title: ACCESS TO LAND
datasets.description: This chapter presents information on families benefited through land access programs, via leasing credits, purchase credits, and land adjudication. The displayed tables are part of the collection of administrative records on Access to Land during 2025, compiled from the source: FONTIERRAS.

datasets.title: SOLID WASTE
datasets.description: This chapter presents information on the impact of social and economic phenomena on the environment due to waste generation. The displayed tables are part of the collection of administrative records on Solid Waste during 2025, compiled from the sources: MUNIGUATE, AMSA, and IGSS.

datasets.title: ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT
datasets.description: This chapter presents the economic and socio-legal implementations carried out for the benefit of the environment. The displayed tables are part of the collection of administrative records on Environmental Management during 2025, compiled from the sources: PNC, MP, MAGA, and MINFIN.

datasets.title: CLIMATE AND ATMOSPHERE
datasets.description: This chapter presents information on the country's climatic variables recorded through meteorological stations and air monitoring. The displayed tables are part of the collection of administrative records on Climate and Atmosphere during 2025, compiled from the sources: INSIVUMEH, ICC, and AMSCLAE.

datasets.title: WATER RESOURCES
datasets.description: This chapter presents the monitoring of water resources across the national territory. The displayed tables are part of the results from the collection of administrative records on Water Resources during 2025, compiled from the sources: AMSA, INSIVUMEH, AMSCLAE, and EMPAGUA.

datasets.title: ECOSYSTEMS
datasets.description: This chapter presents statistical data on actions and activities that contribute to the improvement and sustainability of the country's ecosystems. The displayed tables are part of the collection of administrative records on Ecosystems during 2025, compiled from the sources: INAB and CONAP.

datasets.title: VITAL STATISTICS - DEATHS
datasets.description: Vital statistics result from administrative records of births, fetal and non-fetal deaths, marriages, and divorces, providing information on changes in mortality, fertility, and nuptiality patterns, offering a dynamic view of the population as a complement to the static approach provided by population censuses. These are widely used for calculating demographic indicators of great importance for the health sector.

datasets.title: CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS PRICE INDEX (IPMC)
datasets.description: The National Institute of Statistics (INE) presents the historical series of the Construction Materials Price Indices (IPMC). The IPMC measures the monthly price variation of the eighty-nine (89) materials and services that make up the representative basket of inputs used in construction activity, using December 2018 = 100.0 as the base month.

datasets.title: JUDICIAL MISDEMEANORS
datasets.description: In Guatemala, judicial misdemeanors are described in the Guatemalan Penal Code and are subject to sanctions and penalties by the corresponding authorities. Likewise, a judicial misdemeanor is a minor infraction that does not constitute a crime, and therefore is punished with lighter sanctions.
